subject.title: feat(discord): add canvas-first Discord Activities support

question: Should this Discord Activity work be reworked under the Canvas/Discord plugin contracts with credentialed Activity auth before proceeding, or should only the Entry Point command-retention part be split out?
rationale: The branch crosses plugin ownership, public Gateway auth, token transport, and third-party script execution boundaries; automation cannot safely choose the permanent product/security contract for Discord Activities.

options.title: Rework under plugin ownership
options.body: Move Activity config, routing, SDK assets, and A2UI bridge behavior into Canvas/Discord plugin seams with credentialed or verifiable auth, then re-review a rebased branch.

options.title: Split Entry Point retention
options.body: Land only the Discord deploy retention fix in a small PR while Activity auth and Canvas ownership remain under design review.

options.title: Pause one overlapping branch
options.body: Pick one of this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/18778 as the future Activity branch and close or shelve the other after preserving useful context.

recommendation.title: Rework under plugin ownership
recommendation.body: Move Activity config, routing, SDK assets, and A2UI bridge behavior into Canvas/Discord plugin seams with credentialed or verifiable auth, then re-review a rebased branch.

likelyOwner.reason: The most concrete blocking decision is the shipped Canvas plugin ownership and root config migration boundary.
